title: versorc-math: High-Performance Clifford Geometric Algebra & Versor Quantization Engine
description: A zero-overhead, SIMD-accelerated Clifford Geometric Algebra library and Dyadic Versor quantization engine in Rust and Python, supporting Cl(3,0), Cl(2,0), 3D PGA Cl*(3,0,1), 3D CGA Cl(4,1), 4D Spacetime Algebra Cl(1,3) with full Lounesto spinor classification, Gosset E8 lattice closest-vector decoding, and TurboQuant 3-bit isotropic versor rotations.
